description: This file defines a function `vtws_query` that executes a web service query in the vtiger CRM system. It manages caching of objects like the webservice object, handler, and metadata, and handles permissions and error checking.

classes.name: VtigerWebserviceObject
classes.description: Represents a web service object with methods to retrieve handler path, class, and entity name.

classes.name: WebServiceException
classes.description: Handles exceptions related to web service access restrictions and errors.

classes.name: VTWS_PreserveGlobal
classes.description: Handles global state preservation, particularly flushing global states after query execution.

methods.name: vtws_query
methods.description: Performs a web service query, manages cache for webservice object, handler, and metadata, checks permissions, executes the query via the handler, and returns the result.
